localChanges: A computer player that holds half the world's cities or more now plays for a conquest victory: it builds more attackers, gathers the ones it can spare near its rival's nearest city and attacks together, and once it holds well over half the world it puts conquest ahead of the space race (closes #377).
A computer player's transport no longer unloads the same units over and over in port, and stays in port while they're aboard rather than sailing off with them.

log: feat: conquest as a goal, with a campaign that gathers a player's idle attackers near its target and sends them together once there are enough
fix: a transport unloads once a turn, so cargo that stays aboard in port takes up its own orders instead of being woken again and again
fix: a transport asked again in a turn it has unloaded, with cargo still aboard, stays in port rather than sail off with units that have just fortified there

feat: Civ1 conquest: weighs on a player from half the world's cities to its full weight at three quarters, ahead of the space race past the half way mark; its campaign gathers the attackers the missions had no use for near the rival's nearest city, and twice the attackers are built
